content: {"question":"If I move from a full‑time position in the Netherlands to a full‑time position in Australia, how will my medical allowance or coverage change?","answer":"In the Netherlands you receive a €150 gross monthly allowance with no documentation required, while in Australia you must enroll through the GitLab BUPA portal and pay the full cost of your chosen plan after leaving GitLab.","evidence_a":"Full-time Netherlands team members receive a EUR 150 gross monthly allowance to help cover healthcare costs.","evidence_b":"Visit the GitLab BUPA employer portal… Complete BUPA's application with contact, Medicare, and payment details"}
